RA.why: Links professors to the students who assist them, with capability and salary on the link; the pair is the key.

course.why: Ten courses keyed by course_id with rating and difficulty attributes; registration points at it.

prof.why: Six professors keyed by prof_id with popularity and teaching ability; RA points at it.

registration.why: Links students to courses with grade and satisfaction on the link and no time column.

student.why: One row per student keyed by student_id with intelligence and ranking; RA and registration point at it.
